tldr: Near-perfect treatment codes can offset a vanishing fraction of random chart audits for inference on the original average treatment effect. When coding error and audit probability both equal \(n^{-1/4}\), the attainable variance is the known-design clean variance plus the explicit differential-coding penalty \(K\). A finite corrected-cell histogram and cross-fitted causal correction, with empirical studentization, give uniformly Gaussian inference and \(90\%\) coverage over Lipschitz clean regressions and arbitrary measurable, possibly sample-size-dependent channels. Original-record likelihood information certifies efficiency at every prescribed fixed interior law. An exact same-law comparison recovers Levis et al.\textquotesingle s published coarsening benchmark at the balanced shrinking boundary, although the corrected score has strictly greater variance at each finite row. For these fixed public maps, the sharp uniform calibration order is \(\mathfrak E_n\asymp n^{-1/6}\), with no logarithmic factor and an explicit lawful lower witness.
